name: alakazam_ml_v20
model: The v19 deck, LightGBM weights, features, and guarded ML scope are unchanged. v20 adds deterministic terminal Boss gating, target-ranked KO routes, and bounded target-sized hand control.
model_scope: Live ML remains restricted to safe Abra/Dunsparce bench-role choice and same-evolution-card target choice. Attack, Energy, Trainer, Boss, Hammer, retreat, abilities, and END remain deterministic.
v20_rule_changes: At exactly two or three remaining prizes, make a legal same-turn winning Boss's Orders the absolute MAIN action.
Rank all visible opposing Pokemon from prize race, role, development, and Active-resource value, then try deterministic KO routes in that order.
Generalize the v18 Active-only bitmask route to Bench targets with Boss hand cost, Supporter exclusivity, prevention-Energy Hammer removal, and target binding.
Use ceil(remaining HP / 20) as the target-sized Powerful Hand requirement and stop optional draw only after a route is secured with at least five cards of surplus.
Unify guaranteed net hand deltas, including Dawn +2, and prefer lower overkill when route costs tie.
rejected_or_bounded_changes: No deck or ML retraining change: all requested actions remain deterministic fallback decisions.
No Xerosic hand buffer: Xerosic reduces any larger hand to three, so extra pre-hit cards do not preserve Powerful Hand damage.
No blanket draw cap or deck-out guard: broad target-reached hand gates regressed the v20-v19 mirror and were narrowed.
Target value and route feasibility remain separate so an unreachable high-value target falls through to the next target.
known_limitations: v20 has not been submitted; a public ladder rating improvement is not proven.
The final 500-game v20-v19 mirror is statistically consistent with an even result and is not evidence of an edge.
Top-policy agreement decreased by 0.229 percentage points because the requested Boss and hand-control divergences are intentional.
The fixed-deck mirror does not measure the ex-heavy public metagame where high-prize targeting should have its largest benefit.

Both v20 rollout switches default on; ALAKAZAM_V20_TARGET_ROUTES=0 and ALAKAZAM_V20_HAND_GATE=0 remain diagnostic rollback controls, with ALAKAZAM_V20_HAND_SURPLUS=5 as the conservative default threshold.
